title: MediScan AI
problem: Doctors spend too much time reading and summarizing long medical histories and test results, reducing the time they can spend with patients.
solution: An AI-powered dashboard that ingests patient records, lab results, and notes, providing instant, prioritized summaries and flagging potential drug interactions using LLMs.

title: TrustFund DAO
problem: Managing shared funds for small communities or friend groups lacks transparency and requires trusting a single individual.
solution: A multi-sig wallet interface combined with a DAO voting mechanism that allows groups to propose, vote, and execute transactions securely on-chain.
